{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check the shape after cleaning
print(f'Original shape: {df.shape}')
print(f'After removing QA orders: {df_clean.shape}')

# Check for refunded orders
defective_status = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(defective_status)}')

defective_status.head()"}
